_: byDesign: machine-to-machine routes no screen should ever call. Permanent, each needs a reason. knownGaps: routes that need a screen and do not have one yet. A worklist - it may shrink, never grow.

byDesign.document-file: Opened only through the five-minute signed link that document-link returns to the Documents screen; no screen may build this address itself (test/ward-documents-view.test.mjs checks that).
byDesign.adt: HL7 patient admit/discharge/transfer messages arrive from another hospital system, not from a screen.
byDesign.oru: HL7 result messages arrive from the lab analyser, not from a screen.
byDesign.cda: Clinical document exchange with an outside system.
byDesign.smart-launch: An outside clinical app launches into WardSynQ through this; WardSynQ's own screens never call it.
byDesign.device-ingest: Bedside monitors and pumps push readings in here.
byDesign.device-status: Paired with device-ingest; the device asks, not a person.
byDesign.analytics-extract: Batch pull for reporting, run on a schedule.
byDesign.backup: Runs on a schedule, not from a screen.
byDesign.backup-status: Paired with the scheduled backup job.
byDesign.transmit-send: Outbound message to an outside system.
byDesign.transmit-outcome: The outside system reports back here.
byDesign.outbound-send: Outbound message to an outside system.
byDesign.outbound-destination: Configuration read by the outbound sender, not a screen.
byDesign.registries: Statutory reporting to an outside registry.
byDesign.patient-enrol: Belongs to the patient's own app, not to staff screens.
byDesign.patient-messages: Belongs to the patient's own app, not to staff screens.
byDesign.patient-reply: Belongs to the patient's own app, not to staff screens.
byDesign.patient-revoke: Belongs to the patient's own app, not to staff screens.
byDesign.onco-ae-list: Superseded by onco-timeline, which the Oncology screen calls and which reads the same record types (link, adverse events, chemotherapy). Verified 2026-09-14; a separate screen would duplicate it.
byDesign.onco-chemo-list: Superseded by onco-timeline, which the Oncology screen calls and which reads the same record types (link, adverse events, chemotherapy). Verified 2026-09-14; a separate screen would duplicate it.
byDesign.onco-link-get: Superseded by onco-timeline, which the Oncology screen calls and which reads the same record types (link, adverse events, chemotherapy). Verified 2026-09-14; a separate screen would duplicate it.
byDesign.cardio-ecg-list: Superseded by cardio-timeline, which the Cardiology screen calls and which reads the same record types (link, ECGs). Verified 2026-09-14; a separate screen would duplicate it.
byDesign.cardio-link-get: Superseded by cardio-timeline, which the Cardiology screen calls and which reads the same record types (link, ECGs). Verified 2026-09-14; a separate screen would duplicate it.
byDesign.hl7: HL7 v2 messages arrive from another hospital system over the gateway, not from a screen.
byDesign.backfill: Legacy hospital-id migration, run once per legacy hospital by a StewardMD platform operator (refused for anyone else, test/queue-orgs-onboard.test.mjs). Not a hospital staff feature.
byDesign.clinic: Called by opd.html's setup wizard through a computed path (onboard/clinic or onboard/hospital by workplace type), which the literal scan cannot read. Verified 2026-09-13.
byDesign.hospital: Called by opd.html's setup wizard through a computed path (onboard/clinic or onboard/hospital by workplace type), which the literal scan cannot read. Verified 2026-09-13.
byDesign.recommend: Superseded on the device: onco-plan-flow.js runs the same engine (onco-recommend.js, SMD_ONCORECOMMEND.recommend) over the protocols it already loaded, so the phenotype never leaves the phone. Verified 2026-09-13.
byDesign.roi: Superseded by roi-requests, which the Release of information card calls and which returns the same summary() of every request for the patient. Verified 2026-09-13.
byDesign.round: Superseded by schedule, which the chart's Medication round calls over a time window instead of one dueAt. Both now report an unreadable dose record as unknown, never as not started (test/wardsynq-inpatient-emar.test.mjs). Verified 2026-09-13.
byDesign.flag-critical: Called by the server itself: release-result opens critical loops against the stored report on every release (2026-09-14). This route remains only as an idempotent re-check; a screen button for it would duplicate that automatic step.
